new: A short tour, "How RINF Atlas works", opens on your first visit. Reopen it from Help.
What's new: this list of what is new, improved and fixed in each release, opened from About and Help.
fixed: Typing a line number right after opening the line profile no longer gets lost.

new: Fixed speed bands when you colour the map by maximum speed, so high-speed lines get their own colours.
Full screen line profile: open it over the whole window, Escape brings the map back.
Drag the side panel's edge to make it wider; the width is remembered.
Tunnels and bridges are drawn over tracks, and tracks over sections of line.
improved: A section of line shows one geometry, from its net reference, instead of two.
Elements without a location show an exclamation mark next to their count, with the explanation on hover.
Picking a data quality value in the filters turns on the Data issues layer.
With the vehicle check shown, a click on the map opens the section of line under it.
fixed: A class with no match in the map view counts 0 instead of its total.
The data quality filter matches the Data issues layer again.
No more false data quality findings on border points, NUTS regions and data types.
Typing in a facet's filter box keeps the focus.

new: An element's details say how its position on the map was worked out.
The facet shapes this site runs with can be opened and downloaded from Help.
Draw a class at every zoom with "zoom in to see", for example to colour the whole network.
The current map zoom shows above the scale bar.
Vehicle check: axle load, mass per metre and "No ETCS installed".
A new icon and look, and the app installs with a proper icon.
improved: The list of overlapping elements marks the ones with data issues.
The map loads faster when zoomed out over Europe.

new: Colour the map by a property, such as maximum speed or energy supply.
Vehicle check: see where a vehicle can run, section by section.
Line profile: the track parameters of a line laid out along the distance.
Data quality: ERA's validation results per dataset, on the map and per element.
Open the results in QGIS, ArcGIS Pro or GDAL.
Share a link to exactly this view, including filters and open tools.
Back and forward in the Describe and Graph tabs.
Export the results as Turtle.
A Help button with a short guide.
Pick from a list when a click lands on several elements.
improved: Line profile, vehicle check and the map layers have a tidier toolbar on the map.
The Datasets dialog starts with four key figures.
Classes with elements that have no location say how many are not on the map.
fixed: Datasets no longer disappear from the map while they are being updated.
Short sections of line stay visible when zoomed out.

new: Zoom to a single result from the Results list or the details panel.
The About dialog shows the version.
fixed: About 9,300 elements, mostly in Lithuania, are now drawn on the map.

new: First release: every kind of RINF infrastructure element on one map, with filters, search, details and CSV or Excel export, for PROD and UAT.
